content:
Cold Sweat 是一款對原版友善、高度可自訂且效能優異的 Minecraft 溫度模組。它採用先進的溫度系統，提供全方位的遊戲體驗，內建多種可能幫助或危害你的功能。 有準備的玩家能夠抵禦 Minecraft 嚴酷環境的天氣變化，但如果你被困在荒郊野外，可就沒有第二次機會了！ [![Discord Server](https://imgur.com/5W2wczH.png)](https://discord.gg/cUnhb3Ek3E) [![Wiki](https://imgur.com/LS8jcYX.png)](https://github.com/Momo-Studios/Cold-Sweat/wiki) [![Docs](https://imgur.com/E3TJOkF.png)](https://mikul.gitbook.io/cold-sweat/) ![Fair Use](https://i.imgur.com/3G55Lz2.png)


![](https://i.imgur.com/UPTNuaM.png) **動態溫度系統：受世界環境與玩家狀態影響（包含生物群系、方塊、物品、天氣、海拔等）** ![](https://imgur.com/zkHjThs.png) ![](https://imgur.com/cg1hY5h.png) **協助玩家生存的物品與方塊** ![](https://imgur.com/JY66oAS.png) **盔甲隔熱以抵禦極端氣候** ![](https://imgur.com/rPG3tpz.png) **靠近方塊以提升或降低體溫** ![](https://imgur.com/otCZaYe.png) **溫度計顯示精確數值** ![](https://imgur.com/HMqZC5z.png) **使用水袋快速緩解體溫異常，或作為冷/熱敷包** ![](https://imgur.com/0WqSxyR.png)** **詳細的遊戲內介面與檔案設定檔配置** ![](https://i.imgur.com/W9vKlTk.png) ![Please do not use Configured with this mod](https://imgur.com/wUkB0JE.png) ![Please do not ask for a Fabric port](https://imgur.com/AeJAw4A.png) ## **~ 特別整合支援 ~** **[Serene Seasons](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/serene-seasons)** **[Better Weather](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-weather) (Discontinued)** **[Biomes O' Plenty](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/biomes-o-plenty)** **[Armor Underwear](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/armor-underwear-mod)** **[Oh, the Biomes You'll Go](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/oh-the-biomes-youll-go)** **[Curios](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios)** **[Atmospheric](https://beta.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/atmospheric)** **[Environmental](https://beta.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/environmental)** **[Terralith](https://beta.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/terralith)** **[Thirst Was Taken](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thirst-was-taken)** **[Create](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create)** **[Enhanced Visuals](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/enhancedvisuals)** **[Vampirism](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vampirism-become-a-vampire)** **[WW's Overhauled Overworld](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/william-wythers-overhauled-overworld)** **[WW's Expanded Ecosphere](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/expanded-ecosphere)** **[Weather, Storms, & Tornadoes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/weather-storms-tornadoes)**
*在原版中，每個生物群系都有各自的溫度設定。本模組利用此特性建構溫度系統，因此應能與絕大多數的第三方生物群系模組相容（前提是它們的溫度設定正確 ;)）。* *~*
